concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR-009 (diffusion‑length estimation) is not covered by any task; no task creates or validates `data/processed/diffusion_lengths.csv` nor references FR‑009.

Functional Requirement FR-010 (linearity diagnostic before reporting Pearson results) is absent; no task implements residual‑analysis or lack‑of‑fit testing, and verification steps do not check for it.

The amendment to FR-001 that requires a descriptive preliminary report when fewer than 10 usable samples are obtained is not mapped to any concrete task; the pipeline lacks a fallback task that generates such a report.
Success‑rate threshold (≥ 95 %) from SC‑004 is never verified; T002’s verification checks schema validity but does not assert that the ingestion success rate meets the required percentage.

Functional Requirement FR-007 (co‑location validation) is only mentioned in the description of T005 but no task explicitly performs or verifies this validation step, nor is there a verification criterion ensuring co‑location status is recorded.
